rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for an advantage or positive effect.

example.english: The benefit of this plan is that it saves time.
example.traditional: 呢個計劃嘅好處，就係慳時間。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gai3 waak6 ge3 hou2 cyu3 zau6 hai6 haan1 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this for benefits provided by a welfare or assistance scheme, rather than an ordinary advantage.

example.english: This welfare scheme provides a benefit to many low-income families.
example.traditional: 呢個福利計劃為好多低收入家庭提供援助。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fuk1 lei6 gai3 waak6 wai4 hou2 do1 dai1 sau1 jap6 gaa1 ting4 tai4 gung1 jyun4 zo6

rows.note: Use this when the benefit is an insurance payment.

example.english: The insurance company eventually paid me an insurance benefit.
example.traditional: 保險公司最後畀咗我一筆賠償金。
example.jyutping: bou2 him2 gung1 si1 zeoi3 hau6 bei2 zo2 ngo5 jat1 bat1 pui4 soeng4 gam1

rows.note: Use this for a performance held to raise money for a charitable cause.

example.english: Tonight's charity performance raised a lot of money to benefit stray animals.
example.traditional: 今晚場慈善演出為流浪動物籌咗好多錢。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 coeng4 ci4 sin6 jin2 ceot1 wai4 lau4 long4 dung6 mat6 cau4 zo2 hou2 do1 cin2
